description: The Ashmand main text states a relational Part of Fortune procedure, while footnote 144 reports additional Perugio Latin directional wording that counts from the Ascendant according to the Sun-Moon order. The cited edition does not establish a chart-changing computational fork, but the transmission difference remains unresolved.
why_they_differ: The main text gives the equal-relation and same-day/night procedure; footnote 144 supplies directional wording and says the related Cardan formulation is exactly equivalent. This is a translation and transmission question, not a demonstrated incompatible result.
user_facing_note: Keep the Part of Fortune transmission difference visible; do not present the Perugio wording as a proven competing formula without independent comparison.
